test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Anil offers his customer a discount of 15% on a T-shirt and he still makes a profit of 25%. What is the actual cost of the T-shirt marked ₹500?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 500

Discount = 15%

Profit = 25%

**Formula used:**

Selling price = frac{100- {discount}}{100}times{marked price}

;Selling price = frac{100+ {profit}}{100}times{cost price}

**Calculation:**

Selling price = (100-15)/(100)×500=425

Cost price = selling price × (100)/(100+{profit)} 

Cost price = 425times(100)/(100+25)=340

**∴ The actual cost of the T-shirt is Rs. 340.**
